name: GRS/SPF 50+ 150GSM Mesh Cycling Jersey Long Sleeve (Full Dye Sublimation) #500092
descriptionHtml:
• Premium & comfortable - Unisex Style
  • Eco Friendly material option 
  • Made from 100% polyester, 150gsm - 4.42oz SPF Protected Jersey Mesh Material 
  • Athletic Stretch, Breathable, and moisture wicking fabric.
  • Modern cycling style with 3 storage pockets located on the back.
  • Silicone anti-skid band on the bottom of the cycling jersey to prevent the jersey from sliding up while riding.
  • This fully customizable cyclist’s jersey looks fantastic and is suitable for all levels of cyclists that participate in road, mountain, or exercise biking. This is a quick-dry material that wicks moisture away and breathes to keep you cool and comfortable while in motion. Great for short recreational rides or long distance treks there is ample storage to hold your phone keys, extra water bottles and other essentials.
